about: How cut_packs.py cuts the full dictionary file into the English bundle and the language packs (docs/specs/0237-downloads.md, 'Build and release'). Every row of every table but data_source lands in exactly one file. Pack ids and ord are permanent. 'tables': whole tables; 'rows': a WHERE on the full file's table, :lang is the pack's language, f. is the full file; a table the full file lacks is skipped. 'data_source': the data_source ids that go with the file's data (the wordlist rows' own data_source ids join automatically). 'limited_pairs': learning pairs offered without a dictionary from lang into via, their meanings from the dictionaries of lang into meanings_lang; the bundle's catalog_pair rows.

rows.wordlist_item: series IN (SELECT series FROM f.wordlist WHERE lang = :lang)
rows.example_translation: sentence_id IN (SELECT id FROM f.example_sentence WHERE lang = :lang)
